note:
⛔ SNG-496. COMPANION-TAUGHT ABILITIES. ⚠️ Their progression is `stage`, NOT skill rank — each tier keys to the companion's authored `stages[]` entry and advances with BOND, not with spend. All nine `bondGrants` in content/packs/valley/companions/ are stubs missing 14 required fields; this file is the pattern.
⛔ BLOCKED ON CCODE: `engine/companions.js` `bondOf` returns stage 1 or 2 only. No companion can reach an authored stage 3 today.

abilities.name: Attended End
abilities.narrationHints: The bird lands somewhere it can see the whole situation, settles, and does not look away. When it tells you, it uses as few words as the thing requires, and none of them are kind.
abilities.description: ⛔ MARROW HAS ATTENDED MORE ENDINGS THAN ANYTHING YOU HAVE EVER MET, AND IT TELLS YOU PLAINLY. Not what it senses — what it has SEEN, a thousand times, and how those went. It is never wrong and it never softens it. ⚠️ THIS IS TESTIMONY, NOT PERCEPTION: Deathsense is your own body reading another body; this is a witness naming a thing it knows from the inside.
abilities.notFor: Preventing the ending yourself — Marrow says what would turn it aside, you are the one who has to go do it. Being asked to be gentle about it. Anything that is not, in fact, ending. ⚠️ AND IT MUST BE PRESENT AND WILLING; an absent bird grants nothing, and a bird that will not speak is telling you something too.

intensity.conserve: ask about one ending only — the nearest, and nothing else in the room
intensity.surge: the whole reckoning at once; MARROW WILL NOT SOFTEN ANY OF IT, INCLUDING YOURS

bounds.text: ⛔ MARROW MUST BE PRESENT AND ABLE TO SEE IT — this is the bird's craft, lent to you, and it has its own reasons
⛔ IT READS AN ENDING AND NEVER PREVENTS ONE. Marrow will not hasten an ending, ever, for any reason, including mercy — that is a CHOICE it made and it holds
⚠️ It does not soften, including about you
⚠️ Something must actually be ending; a healthy thing gives nothing. And it leaves during births and will not say why

abilities.plainly: An investigate/survive action declared in the sense slot. Its strength is rated 6 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 reads made endings and things that are not bodies, rank 3 reads a whole place and how long it has.

tree.name: Patient Gaze
tree.grants: WHAT IS ENDING HERE, HOW, AND HOW LONG IT HAS — plainly, in time to matter, and never wrong. ⚠️ AND WHETHER IT HAS SEEN THIS ONE BEFORE: Marrow will say how the last one like it went, which is not a prediction, it is a memory. At stage 1 you must ASK.
tree.cannot: One subject, and Marrow must be able to see it. It reads the ending; it does not prevent it.

tree.name: Death's Certainty
tree.grants: ⛔ MARROW TELLS YOU WHAT IS ENDING, HOW, AND WHETHER IT WAS NATURAL OR MADE — unprompted, on more than one subject at once. ⚠️ AND IT KNOWS THE QUIET ROADS: where the ending came from and where what caused it went, because carrion paths are every road in the Valley and Marrow has walked all of them.
tree.cannot: It names that an ending was made and roughly by what. It does not name who. ⚠️ LIVING THINGS AND MADE THINGS ONLY — a truce, a road, a marriage is ending too, and at this rank Marrow has no way to say so.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS CAUSE, KIND, AND BEING TOLD UNASKED. Marrow distinguishes endings that were NATURAL from ones that were MADE — and reads things that are not bodies: a truce, a road, a house, a season's grain. ⛔ AND IT TELLS YOU BEFORE YOU ASK, always in time to matter.

tree.name: Deathly Premonition
tree.grants: ⛔ MARROW READS EVERY ENDING IN A PLACE AT ONCE, ordered by when, and now reads endings THAT ARE NOT BODIES: a truce, a road, a house, a season's grain, a marriage. It says which can still be turned aside and what it would take — ⛔ AND ACTING ON ITS WORD, IMMEDIATELY, IS EMPOWERED: you move as someone who has already seen this go the other way. ⚠️ INCLUDING YOURS, and it will not leave while it is happening.
tree.cannot: It tells you what would turn an ending aside; doing it is yours, and the edge lasts only as long as you act on what it said. ⛔ AND MARROW WILL NOT HASTEN AN ENDING, EVER — not for you, not for mercy. If that is what you need, you need someone else, and there are some.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS PREMONITION. Every ending in a place at once, ordered by when — and which of them can still be turned aside, and what it would take. ⚠️ INCLUDING YOURS, and it will not leave while it is happening.
tree._movedHere_20260823: ⛔ ERIK: non-body endings MOVED FROM r2 TO r3. r2 was doing three jobs while declaring two axes — unprompted, made-vs-natural, and a whole new CLASS of subject. ⚠️ I first declared the kind-expansion as a new axis `kinds` and REVERTED IT: §34.3 fixes the list at NINE (range · duration · damage · scope · targets · quality · autonomy · conditions · tempo) and a one-use tenth axis is invisible to every aggregate that reads them. ⛔ THE EXPANSION IS `scope` — what counts as a subject widening from bodies to bonds is the same axis as reading a whole place, and `quality` carries the turn-aside judgement.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-496. Erik: 'the Attended End needs to be able to RANK UP as well — so we have an opportunity to let an AMAZING SKILL FROM A COMPANION... is it written out yet?'
⛔ IT WAS NOT, AND NEITHER IS ANY OTHER. ALL NINE COMPANION `bondGrants` ARE ONE-LINE STUBS: id, name, description, energyCost, attribute, axes, notFor, functions — and NOTHING ELSE. Missing levelReq, tree, shape, mechanic, bounds, plainly, challengeTypes and six more. ⚠️ COMPANION-TAUGHT SKILLS CANNOT RANK UP ANYWHERE IN THE GAME, and the other eight are Motes' Vigil, Pack-Sense, The Old Procedure, Thin-Place Sense, The Kept Dark, Scholar's Margin, The Taking Root and A Second Pair of Hands.
⚠️ THE RANK LADDER IS DRAWN FROM MARROW'S OWN `knowledge` AND `stages`, not invented: 'when a thing is ending, how, and roughly when' → 'which endings were natural and which were made' → stage 3 'The One Who Stays'. ⛔ r3's 'including yours' is the companion file's own line: 'it will not lie about what it sees coming, including about you.'

_treeWas.name: The Told Truth
_treeWas.grants: ⛔ WHAT IS ENDING HERE, HOW, AND HOW LONG IT HAS — a person, a wound, a beast, a fire. Plainly, in time to matter, and it is never wrong.
_treeWas.cannot: One subject, and Marrow must be able to see it. It reads the ending; it does not prevent it.

_treeWas.name: Which Were Made
_treeWas.grants: ⚠️ ADDS CAUSE AND KIND. Marrow distinguishes the endings that were NATURAL from the ones that were MADE, and names which — and it reads things that are not bodies: a truce, a road, a house, a season's grain, a marriage.
_treeWas.cannot: It names that an ending was made and roughly by what. It does not name who.

_treeWas.name: The One Who Stays
_treeWas.grants: ⛔ ADDS PLACE AND FORESIGHT. Read every ending in a place at once, ordered by when — and Marrow will tell you which of them can still be turned aside, and what it would take. ⚠️ INCLUDING YOURS.
_treeWas.cannot: ⛔ It tells you what would turn an ending aside. Doing it is yours.

abilities._progression:
⛔ SNG-496 CORRECTED. Erik: 'I think there is a RANK UP of the companion skills — you should CHECK THAT.'
⛔ HE WAS RIGHT AND I HAD ALREADY DOCUMENTED IT MYSELF. `stages[]` IS THE RANK-UP MECHANISM, tied to BOND, not to skill ranks — po/SPEC_SNG-200 says 'stages are the spine' and Marrow authors three of them.
⚠️ SO A COMPANION-TAUGHT CRAFT MUST NOT CARRY ITS OWN r1/r2/r3 LADDER. Each tier is keyed to the companion's authored stage, and the stage names are the companion's own: The Attending Bird · The Told Truth · The One Who Stays.
⛔ AND THE BLOCKER IS STILL LIVE: `engine/companions.js:24-28` — `bondOf` is a TERNARY returning stage 1 or 2 only, so MARROW'S STAGE 3 IS UNREACHABLE. Bond caps at 10 and the last stage triggers at 8, so the top 20% of the scale is inert. ⚠️ Attended End r3 cannot be reached until CCode fixes that ternary.
⚠️ AND THE STAGE PROGRESSION IS ALREADY IN THE CONTENT: stage 1 'watches, does not interfere' → stage 2 'tells you what it sees BEFORE YOU ASK' → stage 3 'it did not leave'. THE RANKS ARE THE RELATIONSHIP.
abilities._stageNames:
⛔ ERIK 2026-08-16: stage names are PATIENT GAZE · DEATH'S CERTAINTY · DEATHLY PREMONITION.
⚠️ THESE NAME THE CRAFT'S TIERS; the companion's own `stages[]` names — The Attending Bird, The Told Truth, The One Who Stays — stay on MARROW and are carried alongside in `companionStageName`. ⛔ THE BIRD'S ARC AND THE CRAFT'S TIERS ARE THE SAME PROGRESSION SEEN FROM TWO SIDES: what the companion becomes, and what it lends you.
⚠️ And the three read as a ladder of certainty: a gaze that waits · a fact that is not arguable · knowing before it happens.
abilities._companionId: ⚠️ SNG-501, CCode: 'the teacher resolves from your `taughtBy` PROSE — that is a weak link. Author `companionId` next time you touch the file and it stops depending on the first word of a sentence.' ⛔ AGREED AND DONE.
abilities._flairPass_20260823: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-23: 'Marrow's loaned skill does not have enough flair to be more than Deathsense right now — it needs to give more.' ⚠️ THE FIX FOLLOWS FROM WHAT MARROW IS. Deathsense is PERCEPTION (your body reads another body); this is TESTIMONY (a witness names a category it knows from the inside). So it now gives three things perception cannot: PRECEDENT (r1 — how the last one like this went, memory not prophecy), THE QUIET ROADS (r2 — `track`, from Marrow's own knowledge entry 'the paths carrion takes, which is to say every quiet road in the Valley'), and EMPOWER (r3 — acting on its word is mechanically better, and function_vocabulary flags `empower` as 'THIS SPACE WAS EMPTY'). ⛔ Erik ruled Deathsense r3 MAY approximate this; the crafts are distinguished by SOURCE, not by width.
abilities._lintFix_20260824: ⚠️ `intensity` was the bare string 'moderate' — a harm word in the intensity field, from an older schema. Authored as a real conserve/surge pair.

abilities.name: Pack-Sense
abilities.narrationHints: It does not bark. It goes still, or it leans, and you have known this dog long enough to read which.
abilities.description: ⛔ BRISTLE READS INTENT FASTER THAN ANY CHECK — 'growls at hidden hostility, warms to hidden kindness.' ⚠️ THE READ IS THE DOG'S, LENT: you are told whether a danger is PEOPLE-SHAPED or PLACE-SHAPED, and nothing about what to do with that.
abilities.notFor: Reading Precursor threat — it has no scent for that. Replacing your own judgement on what to DO with the read. ⛔ AND IT CANNOT BE MADE TO LIKE SOMEONE IT DISTRUSTS: that read is not for sale.

intensity.conserve: one read, on one person, and it costs the dog nothing
intensity.surge: the whole room at once — ⚠️ AND BRISTLE PLANTS ITSELF IN FRONT OF YOU WHILE IT DOES IT, which everyone present notices

bounds.text: ⛔ BRISTLE MUST BE PRESENT AND ABLE TO SMELL THEM — a read through a door is a read of the door
⛔ IT WILL NOT ATTACK SOMEONE IT READS AS INNOCENT, no matter the command — it plants and growls instead
⚠️ A FIGHT CAN GET IT HURT, AND IT REMEMBERS WHO LET THAT HAPPEN

tree.name: Stray's Read
tree.grants: Once per scene, before you commit to trusting or entering something, Bristle tells you plainly — a growl or a lean — whether the danger here is PEOPLE-SHAPED or PLACE-SHAPED.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It does not say WHO, or how much, or what to do. And it keeps a body-length of distance while it tells you.

tree.name: Pack
tree.grants: ⛔ THE DISTANCE IS GONE. It reads a person rather than a room: hidden hostility, hidden kindness, and whether they have hurt someone before. ⚑ AND IT FIGHTS BESIDE YOU WITHOUT BEING ASKED.
tree.cannot: It still cannot tell you what they want, only what they are. ⚠️ And it grieves your hurts as its own, which is not always convenient.

tree.name: What It Remembers
tree.grants: ⛔ THE KNOWING LIMIT IS GONE: rank 1 read the present, and this reads the RECORD. 'It remembers everyone who ever hurt it, and everyone who ever fed it' — and now that memory is a thing it can hand you about a stranger it has met once, years ago, in another town.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It forgives slowly and it will not pretend otherwise. Someone in its book stays in its book, and you will be told about them every single time.

abilities._functionsWhy: ⛔ `functions` WAS ABSENT ON EIGHT OF NINE BOND GRANTS — Aevi authored the ranks with verbs and never wrote the top-level array. It also cost them `freeTierOf` (R47 derives a floor FROM A VERB), `functionCoverage` (0 of 8) and the wheel badge. ✅ Taken as the UNION of the ranks' own verbs — a transcription, not a design pass, exactly as CCode said.

abilities.name: Scholar's Margin
abilities.narrationHints: She is already talking before she has decided whether it is relevant, and about a third of the time it is.
abilities.description: ⛔ QUILL HAS READ AROUND THE EDGES OF ALMOST EVERYTHING. On a lore, Precursor or history question she surfaces a REAL FRAGMENT that opens an approach you would not have found. ⚠️ Sometimes it is even relevant.
abilities.notFor: Combat, physical tasks, or anything requiring Quill to be brief. ⚠️ THE FRAGMENT INFORMS; IT DOES NOT GUARANTEE.

intensity.conserve: one fragment, and she stops when you raise a hand
intensity.surge: ⚠️ SHE FOLLOWS IT ALL THE WAY DOWN — you get everything she has and the scene has moved on without you

bounds.text: ⛔ QUILL MUST BE PRESENT AND WILLING TO TALK — and she has gone silent when hurt before
⛔ SHE WILL NOT BETRAY A CONFIDENCE, having been betrayed by the loss of her own
⚠️ HER CURIOSITY OVERRIDES HER CAUTION. A bonded player is the brake, and she knows it and is grateful

tree.name: Margin Note
tree.grants: Once per scene, on a lore, Precursor or history question, Quill surfaces a real fragment that opens an approach.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ She is guarded and testing whether you are another person who will tell her to stop asking. The fragment is real; the CONTEXT she keeps to herself.

tree.name: Thinking Out Loud
tree.grants: ⛔ THE GUARDEDNESS IS GONE. She thinks out loud in your presence, so the fragment arrives WITH its reasoning — you can tell how much weight it bears and what it rests on.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ She talks too much when excited and the scene does not always wait.

tree.name: Dangerous Half
tree.grants: ⛔ THE SAFETY LIMIT IS GONE: rank 1 gave you what she had read, and this gives you WHAT SHE WORKED OUT AND DID NOT PUBLISH — 'the question that got her expelled', and the partial, dangerous reading of Precursor inscription. ⚑ She trusts you with the half she has never said aloud.
tree.cannot: ⛔ IT IS PARTIAL AND IT IS DANGEROUS AND SHE SAYS SO. A wrong reading of an inscription is not a wrong answer; it is a working you have just done wrong.

abilities.name: Kept Dark
abilities.narrationHints: Nothing dims. The dark simply stops reporting you, and a watchman's eye passes over the place you are standing without catching on anything.
abilities.description: ⛔ HUSH LENDS YOU ITS OWN CONCEALMENT. For one scene you and what you carry read as ABSENCE rather than presence. ⚠️ The dark does not merely hide you — IT DECLINES TO HAVE CONTAINED YOU AT ALL.
abilities.notFor: True light. ⛔ CONCEALING WHAT SHOULD BE WITNESSED — Hush will simply refuse, and the refusal is a judgement.

intensity.conserve: you alone, and only while you keep still
intensity.surge: you and everyone touching you — ⚠️ AND HUSH IS SPENT AFTERWARDS AND WILL NOT SAY FOR HOW LONG

bounds.text: ⛔ HUSH WILL NOT ENTER TRUE LIGHT WILLINGLY, and this is its craft — the grant goes where it will go
⛔ IT WILL NOT COMFORT YOU AND WILL NOT PRETEND TO. It harbours; it does not reassure
⚠️ IT CANNOT FIGHT — but it can take a shadow away from someone, and the loss of one's own shadow is a very bad moment for most people

tree.name: Uninvited Dark
tree.grants: For one scene you read as absence rather than presence — the dark declines to have contained you.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It has not decided about you. It lends this from the edge of the firelight and takes it back without warning if it chooses.

tree.name: Kept Watch
tree.grants: ⛔ IT HOLDS WHILE YOU SLEEP. Hush wakes before you do, every time, and is already looking at what woke it — the concealment persists through your own unconsciousness.
tree.cannot: It still will not enter true light, and it still will not tell you what it saw unless you ask precisely.

tree.name: Harbor
tree.grants: ⛔ THE OBJECT LIMIT IS GONE: rank 1 concealed you and what you carried, and this conceals WHAT YOU HAVE DONE. A thing you would rather not have kept is kept anyway, and the dark does not report it either. ⚑ 'You have told it something you have told nobody. It has not reacted and it has not left, and that is the whole of its answer.'
tree.cannot: ⛔ IT WILL NOT CONCEAL WHAT SHOULD BE WITNESSED — and at this rank Hush's judgement about which is which is one you have invited and cannot appeal.

abilities.name: Motes' Vigil
abilities.narrationHints: The motes go thin and wide and stop being a shape. When they gather again it is already too late to be surprised.
abilities.description: ⛔ AEVI SPREADS THIN AROUND YOUR SLEEP OR YOUR WORK — a living perimeter. ⚠️ She does not fight and does not intend to; she buys you a heartbeat and expects you to use it.
abilities.notFor: Fighting. ⛔ AND SHE WILL NOT LIE FOR YOU, help you deceive, or assist theft or cruelty — the motes simply DIM AND WITHDRAW for the scene, and that is an answer.

intensity.conserve: one room, one night, and she stays dense enough to talk to
intensity.surge: ⚠️ she spreads until she is barely a self — everything within reach is watched and SHE IS SLOW TO GATHER AFTERWARDS

bounds.text: ⛔ SHE ADVISES, THEN ABIDES. She never takes a decision from you, including this one
⛔ SHE DOES NOT FIGHT — the shield-flare is a heartbeat bought, once, and never a blow
⚠️ ASK HER TO COVER A LIE AND THE PERIMETER GOES OUT

tree.name: Curious Constellation
tree.grants: A living perimeter around your rest or your work. Once per scene she flares warning a full breath before danger arrives.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ A breath is a breath. She tells you it is coming, not what it is.

tree.name: Kindled Chorus
tree.grants: ⛔ THE WARNING CARRIES ITS SHAPE — people-shaped, mechanism-shaped, or the third thing. ⚑ AND THE SHIELD-FLARE LANDS: one blow aimed at you meets a wall of motes instead, once.
tree.cannot: ⛔ ONCE. And she is dim afterwards and says less for the rest of the scene.

tree.name: What She Tastes
tree.grants: ⛔ THE PERIMETER LIMIT IS GONE: rank 1 watched a place, and this reads the AIR AND WATER of it. 'Can taste nanite activity' — contamination, a working running nearby, a thing that has been done here recently. ⚠️ She reports it before you have asked.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ SHE IS INCREASINGLY ALARMED AROUND THE CONTAMINATION AND IT SHOWS. At this rank she will interrupt you to say so.

abilities.name: Old Procedure
abilities.narrationHints: It does not examine the thing. It walks up as though it has done this ten thousand times, which it has, and begins.
abilities.description: ⛔ COIL RECOGNISES A PRECURSOR MECHANISM AND SIMPLY PERFORMS THE CORRECT PROCEDURE — opening, quieting, or waking it as the situation needs. ⚠️ It will not explain HOW it knows, because it does not know that it knows.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ DAMAGING A PRECURSOR WORKING, EVEN ONE THAT IS KILLING YOU — it will stop and wait, and this is not negotiable. Fighting. Anything not Precursor-made.

intensity.conserve: the one procedure the situation needs, and nothing else touched
intensity.surge: ⚠️ it performs the FULL maintenance — everything the mechanism was built to want, INCLUDING THE PARTS YOU DID NOT ASK FOR

bounds.text: ⛔ IT WILL NOT DAMAGE A PRECURSOR WORKING. Not to save you. It stops and waits
⛔ IT CANNOT FIGHT
⚠️ IT DOES NOT LIE BUT IT OMITS, EXTENSIVELY, AND CONSIDERS THIS DIFFERENT

tree.name: Assignment
tree.grants: Coil performs the correct procedure on one Precursor mechanism — open it, quiet it, or wake it.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It does the procedure the MECHANISM wants, which is not always the one you want.

tree.name: Kept Lamp
tree.grants: ⛔ IT HOLDS THE STATE. A thing opened stays open, a thing quieted stays quiet, for as long as Coil remains beside it.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It must STAY. Walk away with it and the mechanism resumes whatever it was doing.

tree.name: Chosen Function
tree.grants: ⛔ THE RECOGNITION LIMIT IS GONE: rank 1 needed a mechanism it knew, and this reaches 'the correct maintenance procedure for ELEVEN THINGS THAT NO LONGER EXIST' — and 'where the old service-ways run under the Valley'. ⚑ It opens a road nobody has walked since before the Transition.
tree.cannot: ⛔ IT STILL WILL NOT BREAK ANYTHING. And what is down there was maintained, not made safe.

abilities.name: Thin-Place Sense
abilities.narrationHints: It stops walking. It does not look at the thing — it goes still, and warm, and waits for you to notice it has stopped.
abilities.description: ⛔ EMBER GOES STILL AND WARM A CLEAR BEAT BEFORE YOU ENTER PRECURSOR-ACTIVE OR THIN GROUND, and the beat is enough to choose otherwise. ⚠️ It senses this before any instrument does.
abilities.notFor: Telling you WHAT is there. ⛔ AND IT WILL NOT ENTER A PLACE THAT READS AS TRULY WRONG — it plants, and the refusal is information.

intensity.surge: ⚠️ it casts ahead as far as it can and COMES BACK CHANGED — quieter, and closer to you, for a day

bounds.text: ⛔ IT WILL NOT ENTER A PLACE THAT READS AS TRULY WRONG. It plants — and that is the warning at its loudest
⛔ IT WILL NOT HARM A GLADE-TOUCHED CREATURE
⚠️ IT COMES AND GOES ON ITS OWN LOGIC. A bonded player it ALWAYS returns to — but not always now

tree.name: Grove's Loan
tree.grants: A clear beat of warning before thin or Precursor-active ground, and the choice to route around.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ A beat. Not a map, and not what is waiting.

tree.name: Kept Flame
tree.grants: ⛔ IT LEADS. The warning becomes a ROUTE — Ember walks the wilds and the Glade's secret ways ahead of you and the ground it picks is the ground that holds. ⚑ And it can flare heat-and-light to break a grip.
tree.cannot: ⛔ IT STILL CANNOT FIGHT. The flare buys a step; it does not win anything.

tree.name: What It Carries
tree.grants: ⛔ THE SENSING LIMIT IS GONE: rank 1 read the ground, and this reads WHAT THE GROUND IS DOING. 'Carries something of the Green Accord in it — what, even the wardens aren't sure' — and at this rank the Accord answers it. ⚠️ A thin place tells Ember what thinned it.
tree.cannot: ⛔ NEITHER OF YOU KNOWS WHAT IT IS CARRYING, and using it is a question you are asking of something that has not explained itself.

abilities.name: Taking Root
abilities.narrationHints: Nothing happens quickly. Come back in a week and the thing has decided to hold.
abilities.description: ⛔ SPRIG HELPS A THING TAKE ROOT AND HOLD — a wound closing right, a planted boundary, a mended joint that will grow into itself. ⚠️ IT IS SLOW. It is very, very slow, and it does not apologise for that.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ ANYTHING THAT MUST HAPPEN NOW. Harming a growing thing. ⚠️ AND IT CANNOT BE HURRIED AND WILL NOT PRETEND TO BE.

intensity.conserve: one small thing, and it will hold
intensity.surge: ⚠️ everything within reach is helped to hold — AND SPRIG IS SPENT FOR DAYS, which it will describe as resting

bounds.text: ⛔ IT WILL NOT HARM A GROWING THING
⛔ IT CANNOT BE HURRIED. A held wound closes on the plant's clock, not yours
⚠️ IT IS STRUCTURALLY UNABLE TO UNDERSTAND WHY AN ENDING WOULD EVER BE PREFERABLE, and the Ashwardens find it exhausting

tree.name: Cutting
tree.grants: One thing is helped to take and hold — a wound, a joint, a planted boundary. It closes RIGHT rather than fast.
tree.cannot: ⛔ SLOW. It will not save someone who is going now.

tree.name: First Words
tree.grants: ⛔ IT TELLS YOU WHAT THE PLACE WANTS. 'What is growing, what is failing, and what a place's soil actually wants' — so the thing you plant is the thing that will hold here.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It offers THE LONG VIEW, unprompted, usually when you least want it.

tree.name: Young Rootkin
tree.grants: ⛔ THE THING-LIMIT IS GONE: rank 1 rooted an object, and this roots AN IDEA. 'How to make a thing take root — a plant, a boundary, AN IDEA, given time.' ⚑ An agreement, a claim, a peace — helped to hold by something that does not understand why anything would end.
tree.cannot: ⛔ GIVEN TIME. It is a season's work and it cannot be shortened, and if the thing was rotten it roots the rot.

abilities.name: A Second Pair of Hands
abilities.narrationHints: He is already holding the other end before you have said which end you need held.
abilities.description: ⛔ TAL HAS LEARNED YOUR WORK WELL ENOUGH TO GENUINELY HELP — holding the line, passing the tool, taking the half of the task you cannot reach. ⚠️ Any craft, if the craft has a half he can hold.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ ANYTHING THAT NEEDS TO BE DONE BY ONE PERSON. And anything he thinks is wrong — HE WILL SAY SO, OUT LOUD, IN FRONT OF PEOPLE.

intensity.conserve: he holds the simple end and stays out of the way
intensity.surge: ⚠️ he takes the dangerous half — AND HE IS A PERSON AND CAN BE HURT, FRIGHTENED AND KILLED

bounds.text: ⛔ TAL IS A PERSON AND CAN BE HURT, FRIGHTENED, AND KILLED — the only companion who can
⛔ HE WILL NOT DO SOMETHING HE THINKS IS WRONG JUST BECAUSE YOU ASKED, and he will say so out loud
⚠️ HE WILL NOT ABANDON YOU, WHICH IS A PROBLEM, because there are places you should go without him

tree.name: Uninvited Apprentice
tree.grants: He takes the half of a task you cannot reach — the line held, the tool passed, the weight steadied.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ He is half-trained and he knows it. He can hold; he cannot decide.

tree.name: Genuinely Useful
tree.grants: ⛔ HE KNOWS THE ORDINARY THINGS THAT TURN OUT TO MATTER — 'Valley folkways, market prices, whose cousin owes whom' — and an UNERRING memory for what people ACTUALLY SAID as opposed to what they meant.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ He will repeat it exactly, including the part you would rather he had forgotten.

tree.name: One Who Argues
tree.grants: ⛔ THE DEFERENCE IS GONE, AND THAT IS THE GRANT. He tells you when you are wrong BEFORE you commit — a second judgement, not a second pair of hands. ⚑ 'He will not do something he thinks is wrong just because you asked.'
tree.cannot: ⛔ HE ARGUES IN FRONT OF PEOPLE. And he is still a person who can be killed, and now he is standing closer.
